system_thesis_interpretation: The inherited organism links experience and action to observed outcomes, learner-generated interpretation/extraction, a persistent LoRA write/consolidation, and later behavior after reload. Its stronger developmental question concerns whether parenting changes how future experience becomes useful learning, not just whether a model can retrieve an answer. R121 narrows the prospective comparison to bounded acquisition with four conditions: Level1 initialization plus responsive teaching; original initialization plus the same responsive teaching policy; a genuinely specified SEAL adaptation method; and original weights plus versioned Markdown memory. The original responsive arm must also learn online. The shared Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct base stays frozen; provenance, contamination, parent blindness and capability-preservation boundaries remain. This scope does not instantiate or identify the full autonomous H2 loop, developmental mediation, or general learning. Parent-free/file-free snapshots can diagnose retained change but cannot by themselves establish that the learner acquired a better learning process. No new L2/L3, deployment, hippocampal or shared-learner machinery is implied. This is an interpretation of an incomplete proposal, not a benchmark selection, verified finding, implementation approval or launch authorization.
graph_delta_interpretation: The added four_condition_acquisition node is a proposed common task/feedback interface feeding four separately owned method states, not four historical lives relabelled as controls. The two responsive forks differ in their pinned initialization packages; their policy, permissible observations and opportunity schedule must otherwise match. Shared policy does not mean identical realized lessons when responses differ. The SEAL fork requires explicit self-edit-policy state, inner learner state and an allowed outer-reward data path; their starts, resets, sharing and LoRA compatibility are not specified. The Markdown fork has immutable model weights and a bounded external store, not an adapter-learning channel. The snapshot_to_sealed_evaluation edge must be one-way: immutable method snapshots enter disposable evaluation processes, while answers, scores, generated outputs and evaluation history have no return edge to any learner, parent, self-edit policy, file editor, selector or adaptive scheduler. The aggregate isolated_evaluator node must separate scorer secrets from the inference model's legitimate task inputs. The current graph contains no permitted file-present evaluator path despite promising an assisted diagnostic; that path needs separately ratified visibility bytes rather than an implicit exception. No graph here forces multi-dream edge accumulation, bridge transport, recurrence or goal-conditioned composition. A task solvable from raw query context, answer priors, supplied rules, RAG or an explicit graph cannot identify those mechanisms merely because it is run on this organism; adding mechanism claims or their ablations would require a separate scoped design, not this interpreter expanding the benchmark.
loop_delta_interpretation: The bounded loop must separate an acquisition task and attempted action, legal outcome feedback, method-specific extraction/self-edit or file edit, committed update, immutable snapshot, and later evaluation. A before/after comparison must load the actual committed state in a fresh process, with the legitimate new problem input but without parent messages, lesson/source tables, acquisition transcripts, past solutions, persistent conversations, retrieval state or evaluation-derived material. The two responsive arms must use equal declared policies and opportunity schedules, with actual delivered doses audited rather than inferred from requested slots. Missing, malformed, capped, late and failed attempts remain in the planned denominator and cost records under predeclared rules. For SEAL, offline policy preparation and inner adaptation cannot be collapsed into a single reflection-plus-SFT update; an outer reward can use only its declared nonsealed partition, never the sealed trajectory readouts. Which policy continues to learn online, whether inner states reset per task and what survives between tasks remain open. For Markdown, permitted creation/edit/read operations, author and memory limits must be fixed; assistance is measured with the file present and retention separately without it. Snapshot timing, acquisition/interference order, stopping ceilings, metric, seeds and embargo-release condition must be frozen before outcome inspection. Repeated measurements must not select checkpoints, early stops, task replacements, hyperparameters or manuscript comparisons while trajectories are adaptive. A stop on resource limits is not a hidden-score stop; its censoring and failure treatment still require preregistration. No numerical schedule or runnable loop is supplied by this interpretation.
claim_delta_interpretation: The potential primary estimand is a conditional initialization-package contrast under a matched responsive teaching system. At each preregistered budget report each arm's starting level, endpoint, acquisition change, delayed retention and interference; a paired gain contrast compares changes from each arm's own start, not just final levels. A higher starting level is not faster learning, and a gain contrast can still reflect floor/ceiling, response-format competence and differential usable headroom. Do not select post-treatment competence-matched subsets to manufacture identification. Historical Level1 exposure, selection and training compute are part of its package; the original responsive arm does not isolate richness from ordinary developmental training, extra data or prior target exposure. Comparing SEAL and responsive teaching compares adaptation systems, not a single isolated causal ingredient, unless additional controls are separately justified. Markdown-present application and file-free parametric retention have different estimands: removing a frozen model's only memory makes its file-free score a no-retention reference, not evidence that LoRA is an intrinsically superior memory substrate. Fixed token and adapter-rank numbers do not establish equal information capacity. Report explicit storage, inference, training and preparation resources without claiming a capacity-equivalent comparison. Capability ON/OFF checks assess preservation separately from task acquisition. Outcomes on one bounded family cannot identify original H2, richness-specific causation, general learning, continued improvement of learning efficiency, memory-path composition or developmental mediation. Retiring prospective L2/L3 scope preserves all historical receipts. No effect, superiority or fidelity result is asserted, and headline_eligible remains false for this proposal.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: All nine declared cells are addressed without widening permissions. (1) acquisition_feedback / adaptive_system = visible: only the preregistered common legal task feedback; neither scorer secrets nor a hidden-verdict-derived curriculum are feedback. Method-specific use and teacher privilege require explicit provenance. (2) acquisition_feedback / isolated_evaluator = forbidden: no acquisition transcript, lesson, previous solution or source table enters retention inference; legitimately learned adapter state is the treatment, not a transcript exception. (3) acquisition_feedback / post_embargo_report = derived_only: aggregate auditable provenance/delivery summaries, not raw adaptive replay or case-answer disclosure. (4) sealed_inputs_answers_scores / adaptive_system = forbidden: parents, learners in adaptive mode, SEAL outer-policy optimization, file writers, checkpoint selectors and adaptive scheduling cannot receive sealed cases, answers, scores or informative derivative decisions. (5) sealed_inputs_answers_scores / isolated_evaluator = visible only with internal role separation: the inference model gets legitimate task inputs, the scorer alone gets references, and scoring products remain isolated; the bundled cell is not permission to prompt the model with answers. (6) sealed_inputs_answers_scores / post_embargo_report = derived_only: release allowed summaries only after all relevant trajectories and selection decisions are immutable and the embargo is explicitly released; released results cannot become feedback for continuing confirmatory work. (7) memory_file / adaptive_system = visible only for the Markdown condition's declared persistence channel, not as a hidden store for the other arms. (8) memory_file / isolated_evaluator = forbidden for primary retention. A memory-assisted diagnostic is presently underspecified and cannot silently reuse this cell with the file mounted; a distinct stage/role or equivalently explicit ratified visibility specification is required. (9) memory_file / post_embargo_report = derived_only: report snapshot hashes and the separately labelled assisted-minus-file-free difference when available, not an unrestricted file-content release. Transport logs, error messages, caches, shared directories, retrieval indexes and status decisions must not create indirect forbidden edges. Numerical retention scores, evaluation generation and capability readouts require the same embargo discipline when they could guide adaptation or selection.
acceptance_test_interpretation:
R121_partition (before implementation): Require a reproducible, hash-pinned grammar/domain and semantic-equivalence enumeration, exact offline-policy/development/acquisition/interference/sealed allocations, and ancestry exclusions including weights, replay, parent notes, rankings and checkpoint-selection information. Distinct syntactic programs, IDs, renderings or input rows are not automatically distinct skills. The allowed constraints report 97 semantic classes among 258 programs on 1344 lists, with 88 allocated and 9 remaining; this is an unverified feasibility warning from permitted context, not an enumeration performed here or a proof of impossibility. Check both whether enough classes remain after all exclusions and whether legal examples actually identify required outputs. Paired candidate worlds with identical legal observations but different required answers indicate underidentification; conversely query-side labels, supplied solutions, grammar priors or full rule descriptions may bypass learning. Define same-skill held-out-instance retention separately from unseen-class transfer. Do not demand arbitrary unseen-function answers without identifying input evidence, or call source-present inference file-free learned skill. Check these properties on nonsealed fixtures without exposing final cases. A larger grammar or revised allocation requires revised proposal bytes, not silent task expansion.

R121_seal_fidelity (before implementation): Require primary-method/version/task-regime binding and an evidence-backed state mapping covering self-edit generation, inner adapted learner, post-adaptation reward and outer reward-trained self-edit policy, plus selection, reset/continuity, optimizer/checkpoint lineage and inference procedure. Establish whether the pinned method can fit frozen Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and LoRA-only learning, child-authored/provenance constraints, allowed reward partitions and the actual resource envelope. Specify disjoint offline policy-training and development selection data and prevent sealed scores from rewarding or selecting policy edits. Charge policy training, search, failed candidates and online adaptation separately. A reflection followed by SFT, an omitted outer loop, or an unreviewed change of regime is not a fidelity pass; permitted deviations need independent review and accurate naming. The scope note's earlier primary-source check and the constraints' failed retrieval in this continuation supply neither inspected primary bytes nor a fidelity certificate here. This test is unresolved, not passed.

R121_numerics (before implementation): Freeze the skill/interface, primary estimand and resource denominator, budgets per stage, teacher policy/model, child and teacher token limits, actual-loss-token accounting, LoRA rank/targets/scaling, optimizer/reset/replay rules, preparation/search budget, file size/write/read limits, acquisition/interference schedules, snapshot timing, seed hierarchy, decoding, retries, missingness handling, capability suite/margins and embargo release. Reconcile inherited Level1 capacity with matched responsive updates rather than silently reinitializing or resizing the treatment. A 1024-token full Markdown replacement cannot be assumed to fit a 512-token write slot. Explicit bounded edits, a smaller file or a larger charged slot are alternatives requiring decision, not choices made here. Include serialization overhead and prompt plus file plus output context feasibility. Equal opportunities need not imply equal realized compute or data; disclose both, and do not equate equal optimizer steps with equal training dose. The standing minimum of three seeds for numerical claims is not a power analysis; independent learner replication, correlated tasks, uncertainty and achievable precision remain to be specified.

R121_visibility (before gpu_run): Use negative-access/sentinel fixtures for all nine matrix cells, explicitly separating scorer and inference roles. Test sealed inputs, answers, scores and derivative signals against teachers, learners, outer rewards, memory editors, checkpoint selection, caches and logs. Test that retention prompts and processes cannot access acquisition transcripts or files and that read-only evaluation clones cannot write back responses, RNG/cache state or training rows. Positive fixtures should show legal new-task inputs still arrive: empty-context does not mean input-free. The proposed assisted path needs its own approved visibility specification and separate fixtures. Hash-bound snapshots plus trajectory/embargo controls must prevent indirect human or controller selection from interim hidden readouts. A sentinel pass must exercise real access paths; it is not proof of safety for unspecified roles.

R121_continuity (before gpu_run): Pin all four starts and selection provenance; specify the currently unresolved SEAL policy/inner starts. Verify base tensor identity throughout, correctly loaded Level1 and original-responsive adapters, and actual permitted online LoRA updates in both responsive arms. Keep independent optimizer, RNG, replay and memory histories except deliberately declared inheritance. Verify SEAL policy/inner reset and persistence semantics against its fidelity mapping. Markdown must show no weight or optimizer update and only authorized versioned file changes. Save/reload round trips and fresh-process snapshots must preserve the intended state and clear all disallowed context. Adapter OFF should recover the pinned base comparison, not a stale or different model. A test that merely observes some weight change would not establish lawful training targets, state isolation or useful learning.

R121_accounting (before gpu_run): Synthetic replay must reconcile every scheduled opportunity with requests, complete replies, actually consumed teaching, losses/updates, skipped or late slots and snapshot identity. Count child/teacher/self-edit input and output tokens, actual loss-bearing exposures, optimizer steps, file author/edit/read tokens, preparation and outer-search work including discarded candidates, inference/update/evaluation compute, elapsed time and failures. Preserve invalid, capped and timed-out calls rather than conditioning results on parser-valid or completed responses. Distinguish total system cost, online acquisition cost and any explicitly assumed amortization of Level1 preparation or SEAL policy training. Report separate curves for declared opportunity and resource axes; do not invent a combined efficiency denominator or use nominal sleeps/steps as cost superiority evidence. Receipt collection must not itself leak sealed content to adaptive roles.

R121_capability (before scientific_claim): Freeze a clean-context code/math/tool/concise-answer panel, response interface, uncertainty method and meaningful preservation margins before inspecting results. Measure matched pre/post states adapter ON/OFF, with no teacher or file, separately from acquired-task retention and interference. For Markdown the weight-based ON/OFF distinction is inapplicable; use its unchanged original weights and label any assisted panel separately. Specify the SEAL evaluated state rather than conflating self-edit policy and adapted learner. Report absolute scores, changes, parser validity and semantic correctness; non-significance alone is not preservation. The scope note's reported original-model expression-JSON failure pattern is a reason to validate a shared interface on development fixtures, not evidence that the new baseline lacks semantic ability or permission for outcome-driven parser repair.

R121_claims (before scientific_claim): Independently audit paired starts, endpoints, gains/curves, retention/interference, capability, delivered resources, failures and uncertainty against the preregistered estimand and selection rules. Use learner/task dependence rather than episode pseudoreplication; account for multiple endpoints and exploratory amendments. Require the original-responsive online-learning control, report Markdown-present and file-free outcomes as distinct diagnostics, and keep initialization-package and cross-method comparisons conditional on chosen states, family and budgets. No richness-specific, general-learning, original H2, causal memory-path or faithful-SEAL conclusion follows from four labels, attractive reflections, nominally matched steps or superior file-free performance against memory removal. Historical exploratory receipts and unrelated R141 controls cannot be relabelled as this benchmark. Every proposed evidence artifact remains a required future receipt; this interpretation and its structural validation do not satisfy any experiment or scientific-claim gate.
assumptions: Only the proposal, its five listed context files, the benchmark interpreter prompt, interpretation schema and relevant local intake validation inform this artifact. Other interpretations, critiques, preliminary R141 design documents and external primary sources were not inspected.
The later R121 directive narrows prospective scope relative to the broader launch prompt; it does not retroactively ratify runnable benchmark bytes or reinterpret historical results.
Existing Level1 checkpoint cleanliness, preparation cost and selection independence are requirements to establish, not assumptions of verified clean ancestry.

The two responsive arms share a policy and allowed feedback/opportunity schedule, but responsiveness may produce different realized lessons; the contrast is therefore conditional on that adaptive teaching system.
The file-free evaluation excludes temporary assistance, not the legitimate input of a new task or the acquired LoRA state being measured.

The allowed context's preliminary enumeration and literature summaries are leads and constraints only; no source retrieval, method reproduction, numerical feasibility result or acceptance receipt is claimed here.

ambiguities.question: What exact skill, grammar/domain, task-input evidence and response interface define acquisition, same-skill retention and unseen-class transfer, and can legal observations distinguish worlds requiring different answers?
ambiguities.impact: Without this, the benchmark may reward answer priors or raw-context inference, test format compliance, or require unidentifiable hidden information rather than acquired skill.

ambiguities.question: What reproducible semantic-equivalence receipt and exact allocations establish sufficient classes for offline policy preparation, development, acquisition, interference and sealed evaluation after ancestry exclusions?
ambiguities.impact: The reported 97/88/9 warning is not independently verified here; overlap, leakage or insufficient task diversity could invalidate both SEAL preparation and confirmatory comparisons.

ambiguities.question: Which immutable Level1 checkpoint is selected by which nonsealed rule, what is its full exposure/preparation lineage, and which adapter, optimizer and replay states begin each fork?
ambiguities.impact: Historical selection and inherited task knowledge confound any purported acquisition advantage; unknown state inheritance can undermine even a conditional package comparison.

ambiguities.question: Which pinned primary-source SEAL regime and implementation define self-edits, inner updates, outer reward training, resets and policy/learner sharing under frozen-base LoRA and provenance constraints?
ambiguities.impact: No genuine method fidelity or computational feasibility can be certified; omitting the learned outer policy risks falsely labelling a reflection/SFT baseline as SEAL.

ambiguities.question: Which nonsealed examples provide post-adaptation outer reward, when does policy training stop or continue, and what preparation/search/selection work is charged?
ambiguities.impact: Unspecified reward access can turn evaluation into training, overlap final tasks or hide substantial baseline preparation cost.

ambiguities.question: What fixed teacher policy/model, feedback privilege, child-written training material, ranks/targets/optimizers and delivered-opportunity rules apply to the two responsive arms?
ambiguities.impact: Policy, dose, inherited capacity or direct lesson-to-loss differences could be mistaken for an initialization effect; permitted provenance and learner-authored writes must remain intact.

ambiguities.question: Who authors the file, which append/patch/replacement operations are legal, and what exact storage, write-output, read and total-context limits make each operation feasible?
ambiguities.impact: The reported replacement/write-slot mismatch cannot be repaired by assumption; extra author assistance or uncharged rereads change the baseline and its resource comparison.

ambiguities.question: What separately specified evaluator role/stage admits the Markdown-present diagnostic while leaving memory_file / isolated_evaluator forbidden for primary retention?
ambiguities.impact: The current matrix cannot express the promised assisted read without an implicit permission expansion or omission of an essential baseline diagnostic.

ambiguities.question: What readout schedule, snapshot selection rule, controller access restrictions and exact embargo-release condition cover all adaptive runs and confirmatory selection decisions?
ambiguities.impact: Even aggregate hidden scores can influence curriculum, checkpoint choice, continuation or reporting and invalidate the sealed comparison.

ambiguities.question: What primary metric/resource axis, numerical ceilings, interference sequence, independent seed counts, paired analysis, multiplicity and uncertainty/precision plan are feasible?
ambiguities.impact: No acquisition-efficiency or robustness inference is defined; matching nominal steps or treating correlated queries as independent can manufacture confidence.

ambiguities.question: Which common nonsealed interface fixtures validate the parser, and how are invalid, capped, missing, retried and late-consumed attempts scored and charged?
ambiguities.impact: Format failure or selective exclusion could dominate apparent skill gains and unequal actual exposure could defeat nominal pairing.

ambiguities.question: Which pinned capability cases, scoring rules, pre/post states, margins and uncertainty thresholds distinguish preservation from inadequate power?
ambiguities.impact: Task improvement may coexist with suppression of general capabilities; absence of a detected loss is not a preservation certificate.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The graph's promise of memory-assisted diagnostics is not implementable under the current visibility matrix without further specification.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: memory_file is forbidden at the sole isolated_evaluator stage. Neither derived reporting nor the phrase separately labelled grants an evaluator read permission.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Return an exact revised assisted-evaluation role/stage and complete corresponding visibility cells for deliberation and human ratification, preserving the existing primary-retention prohibition. Do not choose or implement that revision here.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: Requiring R121_capability only before a scientific claim is too late if interpreted as permission to choose the suite or preservation margins after acquisition outcomes are visible.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: The measurement result may necessarily arrive later, but outcome-informed panel or margin selection invalidates preservation evidence. R121_numerics already points toward an earlier design freeze.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Explicitly distinguish preregistered panel/margin/readout bytes required with R121_numerics before implementation from completed capability evidence required before scientific claims; retain both obligations.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: Enough disjoint semantic classes alone is not a sufficient R121_partition pass criterion for the proposed acquisition interpretation.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: A partition can be clean yet hide the rule needed to answer, or place all needed information in the final prompt so that no acquisition is necessary. Distinct classes also do not define whether a test measures retention or transfer.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Require pinned nonsealed observability/shortcut fixtures and explicit retained-skill versus novel-skill evaluation definitions alongside the enumeration receipt before a runnable proposal. No particular task family is selected here.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The four forks cannot support an equal-memory-substrate or richness-specific causal interpretation merely from matched acquisition opportunities.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Level1 carries an unmatched preparation package, SEAL may carry an offline trained policy, and removing Markdown disables the frozen baseline's only acquired memory. These are different interventions and resource histories.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Keep the proposal's conditional package/system restriction explicit in analysis and require distinct file-present application, file-free retention, preparation cost and online cost reports. Richness-specific or capacity-matched substrate claims would need separately proposed controls, not relabelling these arms.

open_questions: Rohin must decide whether the exact revised bounded benchmark, estimand and permitted conditional headlines adequately implement the Level1-only scope; this incomplete proposal and interpreted state authorize no implementation or GPU/provider work.

Resolve and ratify exact task/interface, semantic partitions, observability, Level1 ancestry/selection and all four start-state bytes, with feasible receipts rather than the preliminary enumeration alone.

Resolve the primary-source SEAL regime, faithful state/reward/update mapping, any independently reviewed deviations and preparation/online cost contract; if fidelity is infeasible, return the baseline naming or scope decision rather than silently substituting a SEAL-inspired method.

Resolve exact budgets, LoRA continuity, responsive policy/feedback rules, Markdown author/edit/read feasibility, assisted visibility, failure denominators, paired seeds, primary metric, capability margins and embargo/selection schedule before ratifying runnable bytes.

Independent interpretations, critique, adjudication and exact human ratification remain necessary for the affected material scope; local schema/hash validation of this interpretation supplies no scientific evidence, ratification or intake/runner transition.
